items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Chris Kear, Kid Rainier, I played with him.

ctx.x: Fred Washington? Good. Yeah. I know him pretty good.

Yeah. Now you want to know the fellas that I played with? Yeah. Well, I played with Chris Kelly. Played banjo. Who else was in Chris Kelly's band? Who else was in Chris Kelly's band? Who else was in Chris Kelly's band? Well, I don't know the boys. How many pieces do you have? We had five pieces. Five pieces. Five pieces. No, I played with…
That was real interesting what you were saying about Gayno.
